cues.en: I'm getting to buy, when I put that extra $1,000 or $10,000 or whatever it is, in each month, I'm getting more shares in my VTS AX than I would have gotten otherwise. Now, when you move to the wealth preservation stage, you no longer have that income stream to smooth the ride. And that, in my world, is when you add bonds.
cues.zh: 我能买得更多了，每个月我额外投进去的那 1,000 美元、10,000 美元或者随便多少钱，都能让我买到比平时更多的 VTSAX 份额。波动性反而成了你的优势。所以你能睡得安稳，因为你根本不在乎“市场先生”会怎么走。可当你进入财富保值阶段后，就不再有那笔收入流来平抑波动了。按我的思路，那时候就该配置债券了。

cues.en: And bonds become like ballast in your sailing ship, where your flow of income was before. Now you're going to replace that with a ballast of bonds. And that means that when the market plunges, the stocks plunge, and you reallocate to stay at whatever allocation you've chosen, you'll be selling bonds, which have gone up as a percentage of your portfolio. Let's say, as I do at the moment, you have 30% bonds.
cues.zh: 债券就像你帆船上的压舱石，替代了你以前的收入现金流。现在你用债券这种压舱石来取代它。这意味着当股市暴跌、股价大跳水时，为了维持你设定的资产配置比例进行再平衡，你就会卖出债券，因为它们在你的投资组合中所占的比例上升了。比方说，就像我目前这样，你有30%的债券。

cues.en: 70% stocks Well, when stocks plummet that percentage of bonds is going to go up You sell some of those bonds and you're buying those stocks at lower prices just like your cash flow was allowing you to do it before when stocks go back up again and Suddenly that percentage of stocks starts to outweigh where you want it to be it gets above 70 You start selling some of those off to replenish your bonds
cues.zh: 70%的股票。那么，当股票暴跌时，债券的占比就会上升。你卖出一部分债券，以更低的价格买入那些股票，就像你之前的现金流允许你做的那样。当股票回升，股票占比突然超过了你的预期目标，比如超过了70%，你就开始卖掉一部分股票来补充你的债券。

cues.en: With those two strategies, you no longer have to care whether market is going up or down because you know that over time the market is going to go up and you've eliminated the concerns with volatility.
